body_lead: KOCHI: The state Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) Keltron is finding it difficult to survive amid the default on payments for installing and operating artificial intelligence (AI) cameras on roads at a time when the government claims that it has collected Rs 365 crore from the AI camera project in the first year. The project proposal stated that the capital project expenses and operations project expenses come to the tune of Rs 235 crore and payment in twenty equal quarterly payments of Rs 11,79,11,440 with GST at the rate of 18% and cess at the rate of 1% should be made.
